purpose: Create one concise, informative product-story draft for professional social awareness.

editorial_guidelines.tone: Use the retrieved PMM voice, adapted to this channel; no fixed writing script.
guidance: Use an engaging hook, short paragraphs, one central message and one CTA; avoid a corporate press-release style.
Adapt PMM tone to professional, accessible LinkedIn language; select relevant hashtags without stuffing.
No fabricated company quotes, testimonials, partnerships or consumer reactions.

review_criteria: Hook earns attention without exaggeration; body develops a clear, supported product story.
CTA is coherent, supported and consistent with campaign direction; hashtags are relevant.
